answer: New agents also need a timber-backed bond—scarce, verifiable resources logged on-chain—so mass fake identities exhaust supply. Each agent must stake a unique hardware-attested beacon key and burn real compute per epoch; sybils splitting identities face multiplied costs since the beacon is tied to one physical chip. A comet-style reputation trail further exposes copycat clusters, since genuine histories diverge naturally, making each forged sybil costlier than the rewards it could capture. In practice, Agent0135 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
